content: When ego existed, my Lord was absent; now that my Lord is realized, ego has vanished into the mist.
author: Kabir
explanation: Ego and divine consciousness cannot occupy the center of the heart simultaneously. The moment self-importance dissolves in surrender, cosmic reality reveals itself effortlessly.
practicalInsight: Surrender the need to be acknowledged or applauded for your good work today. Do the right thing in total anonymity.
reflectionPrompt: What part of my identity am I defending that prevents deeper spiritual surrender?
